Name: Service Communications Message Registry
Description: This registry defines messages to be used by a service to indicate communication problems with clients or other services.

NameResolutionFailure.Description: Indicates that DNS or other name resolution failed on the indicated name.
NameResolutionFailure.LongDescription: This message shall indicate that DNS or other name resolution failed on the indicated name.
NameResolutionFailure.Message: There was an error resolving the name '%1'.
NameResolutionFailure.Example: There was an error resolving the name 'Contoso.com'.
ArgDescriptions: The network name that could not be resolved.
ArgLongDescriptions: This argument shall contain the network name of the remote service that could not be resolved.
NameResolutionFailure.Resolution: Check your name server settings or the name provided.

ConnectionRefused.Description: Indicates that a connection to the remote service was refused.
ConnectionRefused.LongDescription: This message shall indicate that a connection to the remote service was refused.
ArgDescriptions: The network name of the service that refused the connection.
The port number that was refused.
ArgLongDescriptions: This argument shall contain the network name of the remote service that refused the connection.
This argument shall contain the port number that was refused.
ConnectionRefused.Resolution: Check the settings on the remote service or the port settings.

ConnectionTimeout.Description: Indicates that a connection to the remote service timed out.
ConnectionTimeout.LongDescription: This message shall indicate that a connection to the remote service timed out.
ArgDescriptions: The network name of the service that timed out.
The port number that timed out.
ArgLongDescriptions: This argument shall contain the network name of the remote service that timed out.
This argument shall contain the port number that timed out.
ConnectionTimeout.Resolution: Check the settings on the remote service or the port settings.

HTTPFailure.Description: Indicates that an HTTP failure code was returned.
HTTPFailure.LongDescription: This message shall indicate that an HTTP failure code was returned.
ArgDescriptions: The HTTP status code that was returned.
The network name of the service that returned the status code.
ArgLongDescriptions: This argument shall contain the HTTP status code indicating an error that was returned.  This argument should contain a value in the `4XX` or `5XX` range.
This argument shall contain the network name of the remote service that returned the status code.
HTTPFailure.Resolution: Check the payload settings and the remote service for errors.

SecureCommunicationFailure.Description: Indicates that a secure communication connection could not be established, such as during TLS handshaking.
SecureCommunicationFailure.LongDescription: This message shall indicate that a secure communication connection could not be established.  Services shall use the `CertificateVerificationFailure` message if the failure was due to certificate verification.
SecureCommunicationFailure.Message: Unable to establish a secure communication connection with '%1'.
SecureCommunicationFailure.Example: Unable to establish a secure communication connection with 'https://contoso.com'.
ArgDescriptions: The network name of the service that could not establish a secure communication connection.
ArgLongDescriptions: This argument shall contain the network name of the remote service that could not establish a secure communication connection.
SecureCommunicationFailure.Resolution: Check the configuration settings of the service and the remote service.

CertificateVerificationFailure.Description: Indicates that the certificate of a remote service could not be verified, such as if the certificate is signed by an unknown certificate authority.
CertificateVerificationFailure.LongDescription: This message shall indicate that the certificate of a remote service could not be verified.
CertificateVerificationFailure.Message: The certificate from '%1' could not be verified and is untrusted.
CertificateVerificationFailure.Example: The certificate from 'https://contoso.com' could not be verified and is untrusted.
ArgDescriptions: The network name of the service that provided a certificate that could not be verified.
ArgLongDescriptions: This argument shall contain the network name of the remote service that provided a certificate that could not be verified.
CertificateVerificationFailure.Resolution: Check the certificate settings of the service and the remote service.
